text_block_list.text:
After my training session with Eishin
Flash...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Nakayama. Are you about to begin
training?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
You could say that... But I ain't feelin' it
right
now.
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Are you under the weather,
perhaps?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
That ain't it. There's just nothing thrillin'
about
practice, y'know?
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text:
I can't say I've ever thought about that
before...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Why don't you try doing pair running
with a
partner?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Pair runnin'? Now that sounds fun! Some fierce competition oughta do the trick.
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text:
You're the one who brought it up, so
why don't
you be my running partner?
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text: Me? I suppose that would be fine.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Trainer. May I have your
permission to
join Nakayama?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
If it is thrilling competition you crave,
then I will
not hold back. I shall do my
utmost to meet your
expectations.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Heh! Haha! I like the way you think!
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text:
Understood. Too much practice can
certainly be
detrimental.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: You can go pair running another day!

text_block_list.text: Yes! That would be nice.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I apologize, but can we reschedule for
another
time? When do you have an
opening?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Not happy with just a verbal agreement,
huh?
You sure like to do things clean.
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text:
After Эйсин Флэш sets up a day to go
pair running
with Накаяма Феста, she
goes right back to her
dorm.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, the two dive right into pair
running.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
